description: Pipeline to save search to an Elasticsearch index

stages.script: async function handleRequest() { try { const res = await fetch(`http://${context.envs.origin}/${context.envs.saved_search_index}/_doc`, {method: 'POST', body: context.request.body, headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Basic ${btoa(context.envs.saved_search_credentials)}`} }); } catch(e) { console.log('error', e); } return {}; }
